skill.name: pre-send-check
skill.description: Runs a final verify_email pass on every contact in a loaded Instantly, Smartlead or LinkedCamp campaign, labels each address verified, catch-all, unknown or invalid, and pauses risky contacts before launch. Use when someone says "check this campaign before I send", "pre-send check", "verify my sequence list" or "pause bad emails before launch".
skill.summary: Verify campaign email addresses with Leadsets and review a list of contacts to pause before sending.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The command, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives; the Leadsets MCP endpoint is a real, documented network integration. Verification sends campaign addresses to Leadsets and can consume quota before a separate authorization checkpoint. The instructions may omit duplicate contact records from pause actions and conflict with report-only mode.

remediation.issue: Verification transfers campaign addresses and consumes enrichment quota without a separate checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Before the first verification call, ask the user to approve the destination, campaign scope, and maximum record usage. Send only email addresses and stop when the approved limit is reached.

remediation.issue: The final checks conflict with report-only mode.
remediation.suggestion: In report-only mode, prohibit sequencer writes and list proposed changes separately. For write mode, require approval for the campaign, affected contacts, and actions before applying changes.

remediation.issue: Deduplication may discard contact IDs needed to apply pauses.
remediation.suggestion: Verify each normalized address once, but retain every associated sequencer contact ID. Reconcile pause results against all approved in-scope IDs and report any failures.

semantic_findings.title: No explicit approval before external verification
semantic_findings.description: The workflow sends a campaign address to Leadsets as a probe, then verifies the rest against account quota. The confirmation step applies to sequencer changes, not to data disclosure or quota use in either mode.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The usage and verification steps precede the only explicit confirmation. The workflow reports estimated volume before verification but does not say to wait for approval.

semantic_findings.title: Report-only mode conflicts with pause checks
semantic_findings.description: The skill offers report-only mode, but the final checks require invalid contacts to be inactive and actual pauses to match the report. An agent could interpret those checks as requiring campaign changes in report-only mode.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The pause step asks for confirmation or preapproval, but the final checks are not limited to write mode. No evidence of an actual unauthorized update was found.

semantic_findings.title: Deduplication can leave duplicate contact records active
semantic_findings.description: The workflow drops duplicate addresses before verification without preserving an explicit mapping to every sequencer contact ID. If a duplicate has a different ID, the pause list may omit that record.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions retain contact IDs and drop duplicates, but never restore all IDs when applying pauses. The impact depends on whether the sequencer permits duplicate addresses.

content.user_title: Check Campaign Email Addresses Before Sending
content.value_statement: Campaign lists can contain outdated or unconfirmed email addresses. Verify them with Leadsets and review which contacts to pause before launch.
actual_capabilities: Reads contacts from a connected sequencer or a CSV export and notes duplicate or blank addresses.
Checks Leadsets usage, verifies one address first, and sizes other batches to the available quota.
Separates verified, catch-all, unknown, and invalid results without labeling uncertain addresses as verified.
Prepares a pause list and can apply approved changes through a supported sequencer connection.
Reports verification counts, contact-level results, and reasons why some addresses were not checked.
limitations: Verification requires a Leadsets account with an MCP connection or a REST API key.
Verification uses enrichment quota and sends addresses to Leadsets even in report-only mode.
Without a sequencer connection that supports updates, the skill provides a pause list rather than changing the campaign.
The skill does not send, schedule, or launch campaigns, find replacement addresses, or delete contacts.

use_cases.title: Review a first outreach campaign
use_cases.description: Check a loaded Instantly campaign and review which invalid or unknown contacts to pause before launch.

use_cases.title: Review unsent contacts in a sequence
use_cases.description: Check only Smartlead contacts who have not received a step, and separate catch-all results for review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a client pause list from an export
use_cases.description: Use a LinkedCamp CSV export to prepare a pause list when the client controls campaign updates.

prompt_templates.title: Review a CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets to check the email addresses in this campaign CSV. Return a report only and do not update a campaign.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a CSV export and need a verification report.

prompt_templates.title: Check contacts who have not received a step
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the contacts who have not received a step in my Instantly campaign [campaign name]. Show all four verification statuses and list any unchecked contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to review the remaining contacts in a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Review pauses and catch-all handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Smartlead campaign [campaign ID]. Propose pausing invalid and unknown contacts and separating catch-all contacts. Wait for my confirmation before changing the campaign.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a connected campaign and want to review changes before they are applied.

prompt_templates.title: Plan verification across usage windows
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Leadsets quota for LinkedCamp campaign [campaign ID] before verifying any addresses. Propose batches by send order and wait for approval. Report records used, unchecked contacts, and when to resume. Do not update the campaign.
prompt_templates.scenario: A large campaign may need more than one usage window.

output_examples.input: Check this campaign export and return a report only.
output: Of 100 addresses checked, 82 were verified, 10 were catch-all, five were unknown, and three were invalid.
The pause list contains eight contacts. No campaign changes were made.

output_examples.input: Verify this Smartlead campaign and apply the approved pause list.
output: Of 145 addresses checked, 128 were verified, nine were catch-all, five were unknown, and three were invalid.
Eight contacts were paused after approval. Nine catch-all contacts were kept separate from the main send.
Five addresses were not checked because the current usage window was exhausted.

best_practices: Confirm that you may share campaign addresses with Leadsets before starting verification.
Review the campaign scope and available quota before approving a large verification run.
Check the proposed pause list and catch-all handling before authorizing sequencer changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat catch-all, unknown, or unchecked addresses as verified.
Do not assume that report-only mode keeps email addresses local.
Do not treat a pause CSV as proof that the sequencer was updated.

faq.question: Which campaigns can I check?
faq.answer: The skill names Instantly, Smartlead, and LinkedCamp. It can also read a CSV export when no sequencer connection is available.

faq.question: Which contacts are checked by default?
faq.answer: The default scope includes contacts who have not received a campaign step. You can ask to include all contacts.

faq.question: Does report-only mode still use Leadsets?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends addresses to Leadsets and uses enrichment quota. Request report-only mode when you do not want sequencer changes.

faq.question: What happens to catch-all addresses?
faq.answer: They are not treated as verified. The default is a separate low-volume segment, but you can request that they be paused or left active.

faq.question: What happens if the quota runs out?
faq.answer: The report lists unchecked contacts and explains when you can resume if the service provides that information.

faq.question: Does the skill launch or schedule the campaign?
faq.answer: No. It verifies addresses, reports results, and can apply approved contact changes, but it does not launch, schedule, or send campaigns.
